image_description: A wooden staircase with white risers and treads, featuring a decorative wrought-iron balustrade with ornate red scrollwork. A smooth wooden handrail runs along the top of the ironwork, supported by vertical metal spindles and anchored by a wooden newel post at the bottom. The background shows a beige wall and a glimpse of a hallway with hardwood flooring.

artifact_observations.location: Connection between handrail and iron scrollwork
artifact_observations.reasoning: The connection points where the wooden handrail meets the thin metal spindles appear slightly fused or ambiguous. The metal seems to melt into the wood without clear mechanical fasteners or distinct boundaries in some areas.
The red paint on the ironwork has a slightly uniform, plastic-like sheen that lacks the micro-texture of real painted metal, appearing somewhat digitally smoothed.
The vertical lines of the door/window frame in the background seem slightly warped or inconsistent with the perspective of the staircase, though subtle.
